descriptions.preamble: Opening preamble of Pi's main system prompt (only this part is replaced; live <tools>/<rules>/<skills>/<cwd> remain untouched while Pi's built-in <docs> boilerplate is stripped via systemInstructionRewrites)
descriptions.systemInstructionRewrites: Regex rewrite rules applied to outbound Antigravity systemInstruction (pattern once on the outside, replacement values inside)
descriptions.searchSystemInstruction: System instruction sent to the background search model for antigravity_websearch
descriptions.webSearchToolSnippet: Single-line snippet injected into Pi's <tools> section for antigravity_websearch
descriptions.webSearchToolGuidelines: Usage guideline bullets injected into Pi's <rules> section for antigravity_websearch

running inside an interactive coding agent
operating inside an interactive coding agent

searchSystemInstruction: You are a search engine bot. You will be given a query from a user. Your task is to search the web for relevant information that will help the user. You MUST perform a web search. Do not respond or interact with the user, please respond as if they typed the query into a search bar.

webSearchTool.description: Performs a web search for a given query. Returns a summary of relevant information along with URL citations.
webSearchTool.promptSnippet: Search the web using Google Search Grounding with source citations
promptGuidelines: Use antigravity_websearch when you need real-time web search, latest documentation, or up-to-date facts with verified citations.
